good: In good shape, a few improvements left
scoreSummary: {passed} of {total} checks passed. The list updates as you edit.

title.title: Name and target title
title.present: Your title is the most-read line on a first scan. Use the same wording as the job ad.
title.absent: Add the title of the role you’re applying for under your name.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.absent: Include both an email and a phone number.

profile.title: Profile link
profile.present: Links are clickable in the PDF.
profile.absent: Add a LinkedIn, GitHub or portfolio link; recruiters usually check.

metrics.title: Measurable results
metrics.low: {percent}% of bullets contain a number. Quantify at least a third (%, count, time, users).
metrics.good: {percent}% of bullets contain a number. Good.

bulletLength.title: Bullet length
bulletLength.long: {n, plural, one {# bullet exceeds} other {# bullets exceed}} {limit} characters; bullets over two lines get skipped.

dates.title: Dates
dates.incomplete: {n, plural, one {# entry is} other {# entries are}} missing dates.
dates.complete: Every experience and education entry has dates.

skills.title: Skills
skills.present: Skill groups help ATS keyword matching. Use the exact spelling from the job ad.
skills.absent: Add a skills section; ATS match keywords from it.

length.title: Length
length.good: About {n, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}. 1–2 pages is ideal.
length.long: About {n, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}. Hide old or unrelated entries with the eye icon.

personalData.title: Personal data
personalData.present: ID numbers, marital status or date of birth don’t belong on a resume; remove them.

contrast.title: Colour contrast
contrast.good: White text on the coloured area has {ratio}:1 contrast. Readable.
contrast.low: White text on the coloured area has {ratio}:1 contrast. Pick a darker colour (at least 4.5:1).

photo.title: Photo
photo.present: Common in Turkey and Germany. Turn it off for the US, UK and Canada.
photo.absent: No photo shown. Recommended off for the US, UK and Canada.

ats.title: ATS compatibility: {score}/5
ats.full: Single-column template; applicant tracking systems read it without issues.
ats.partial: For large companies using ATS, prefer the ATS Classic or Modern template.

guide: Tailor the title, summary and skill order to each job; reuse the ad’s keywords with the same spelling.
Name the file Firstname_Lastname_CV.pdf (Download PDF suggests this for you).
Open the PDF, select all text and paste it somewhere; if it pastes cleanly, ATS can read it.
Leave out salary expectations or referee phone numbers unless the ad asks for them.
